title: NetDecoyAttackTypes
description: Standardized attack types, default risk weights, severities, and associated attack stages for NetDecoy.

BRUTE_FORCE.name: Brute Force Authentication
BRUTE_FORCE.description: Repeated failed authentication attempts against authentication decoys in a short time frame.

SCANNING.name: Reconnaissance / Endpoint Scanning
SCANNING.description: Probing multiple distinct decoy endpoints or administrative paths to map application structure.

SQL_INJECTION.name: SQL Injection Pattern
SQL_INJECTION.description: Controlled detection of structured SQL syntax patterns (auth bypass, UNION operators, comments) in decoy inputs.

PATH_TRAVERSAL.name: Directory Path Traversal
PATH_TRAVERSAL.description: Controlled detection of directory escape sequences (e.g., ../, ..\, encoded separators) in search or file decoys.

SENSITIVE_ACCESS.name: Sensitive Resource Enumeration
SENSITIVE_ACCESS.description: Direct interaction with decoy sensitive backup archives, configuration dumps, or synthetic proprietary databases.

PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.name: Privilege Escalation
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.description: Attempts to elevate session permissions, forge tokens, or bypass role checks.

DATA_EXFILTRATION.name: Data Exfiltration Probe
DATA_EXFILTRATION.description: Attempts to download fake confidential honey-tokens, database dumps, or keys.

REPEATED_SUSPICIOUS.name: Repeated Suspicious Behavior
REPEATED_SUSPICIOUS.description: Persistent, multi-vector suspicious activity observed across the session timeline.
